dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - July 26, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**RAYS SHUT DOWN GUARDIANS IN TIGHT 1-0 WIN**

Parker Messick pitched a strong 7.0 innings, but it was Drew Rasmussen who stole the show, tossing 7.0 scoreless innings and striking out 9 batters in the Tampa Bay Rays' 1-0 win over the Cleveland Guardians. Chandler Simpson was the lone bright spot for the Guardians, who were unable to muster much offense against the Rays' strong pitching.

**NATS EDGE DIAMONDBACKS IN WILD 10-7 WIN**

The Washington Nationals overcame a 7-10 deficit to defeat the Arizona Diamondbacks 10-7. CJ Abrams was the star of the show, hitting 2 home runs and driving in 3 runs. Ryan Waldschmidt and Ketel Marte also had big games for the Nationals, who were aided by a strong bullpen effort.

**PITTSBURGH PIRATES COME FROM BEHIND TO BEAT CUBS 8-7**

The Pittsburgh Pirates trailed 7-3 in the 8th inning, but scored 5 runs in the 8th and 9th to defeat the Chicago Cubs 8-7. Seiya Suzuki hit a 2-run homer in the 4th inning for the Cubs, but it was not enough to overcome the Pirates' late-game rally. Ryan O'Hearn hit a 3-run homer for the Pirates in the 9th inning to seal the win.
